items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20.12.2024, sent by simple post. Per the letter's own rule and § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting: Fri 20.12 + 3 days = Mon 23.12.2024 (deemed delivery/Bekanntgabe). Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month period starts running on 24.12.2024. Per § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB the one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 23.01.2025 (Thursday). That day is a normal business day (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X applies. Final deadline: 23.01.2025.
